title: The Final Archive
author: Xanthe Ravensworth
blurb: Ansel Brightwater, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
